verdict.rationale: Phaser's own pricing docs say games you create keep working after the licence ends and that project files can be transferred to VS Code. The framework itself is MIT-licensed and games are plain JavaScript/TypeScript, so there is a documented exit path. However, nothing documents an explicit export of all user data, such as hosted Game Agent projects or account data, in specified open formats. Missing for 10: a documented full-data export feature, export coverage for hosted Agent/MCP projects, a specification of the open formats used, and independent or hands-on corroboration of leaving cleanly.
